title: Bosscha Observatory Clarifies Viral 'UFO' Sighting in Cimahi
description: Bosscha Observatory researchers urged the public not to rush to conclusions over a viral photo claiming to show a UFO in Cimahi, West Java.

title: 'Tall, Grey, Large Eyes': Ex-Air Force Member Recalls UAP Encounter Memories via Hypnotic Regression
description: Former Australian Air Force member Troy Gavin describes an alleged UAP encounter recalled under hypnosis, raising questions about memory reliability

title: Phetchaburi temple uses UFO to teach dharma
description: A temple in Phetchaburi has used a spaceship as a platform for a sermon during the Loy Krathong festival this year, marking a novel departure from the usual look of merit-making events.

title: Ex-Pentagon Contractor Says UFO Encounter With 62 Schoolchildren Suggests Aliens Are Warning Us Over Earth
description: Former Pentagon contractor Gary Moshier says the 1994 Ariel School encounter involving 62 Zimbabwean pupils may have carried an environmental warning, although no verified evidence proves an alien origin.
